newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-OPSM sees ongoing business growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-OPSM sees ongoing business growth.

text.p: Optical products group OPSM Protector Ltd said on Thursday it expected to continue to benefit in the second half of the 1996/97 year from restructuring and growth of its three business groups.
OPSM Protector earlier reported a net profit for the first half year to December 31 of A$12.59 million, up 13.3 percent on the previous corresponding period.

"This is a very good result for a period when consumer confidence was subdued and employment remained weak in several of the sectors in which our Protector businesses operate," chief executuve Jeff Kelly said in a statement.
The result showed the benefits of management strategies to revitalise the company, he said.
Kelly said eyewear and eyecare division, the OPSM Group, lifted earnings before interest (EBIT) and tax by 14.2 percent to A$11.4 million.
The company had reversed a decline in margins, while the profit lift came mainly from tighter control of expenses and improved labour productivity.
The Protector Safety Supply Group, which distributes protective equipment and industrial workware, increased sales slightly, but EBIT fell 7.4 percent to A$6.3 million.
The earnings shortfall was due mainly to start-up costs related to a new contract in New Zealand, Kelly said.
The Protector Technologies Group, which designs and makes protective equipment and safety systems, increased EBIT 51.3 percent to A$4.5 million.
This came from improved productivity and increased sales in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific by the emergency and medical products business.
OPSM shares were five cents lower at A$3.05 on 10.35 a.m. (2335 GMT).
